item.title: What is a neutrino anyway? A look at the science behind this year's Nobel Prize in Physics
item.description: If you wanted a Nobel Prize, you would do well to study neutrinos. item.title: Ultrafast light pulses track molecular motion with three-femtosecond resolution

item.title: Shrinking iron films strengthens laser-driven demagnetization
item.description: From photos and videos to documents, vast amounts of data are stored on hard drives in large data centers. One possible approach involves ultrashort laser pulses, which can alter the magnetic order of materials in an extremely short time. Fuente: Phys.org.
